# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic begins Nasdaq trading in landmark AI IPO](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-nasdaq-debut.html): Anthropic’s public debut turns frontier-model development into a public-market test of safety promises, spending needs, and investor appetite. The offering priced at $83 a share and raised about $81.34 billion; shares closed their first trading day at $97.17, roughly 17% above the IPO price.
- [Google gives Gemini control of Mac apps and websites](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-mac-computer-use.html): Gemini’s Mac app can now click, type, and complete workflows across desktop software, local files, and websites in the background.
- [Ideogram 4.6 targets precise multi-step image editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ideogram-4-6-image-editing.html): Ideogram 4.6 adds focused edits, up to five references, and native 4K output, positioning image generation around production control.
- [Runway unveils Praxis-1 video-action model for robots](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/runway-praxis-robotics.html): Runway’s 27-billion-parameter Praxis-1 combines video prediction with action control, aiming to make robot learning faster and cheaper.
- [Sakana AI launches public-interest security research group](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sakana-ai-security-research-group.html): Japan’s Sakana AI has created an independent security team focused on AI-driven cyber defense, reproducible benchmarks and safeguards for AI agents.
- [Signal blocks phone AI agents from reading private chats](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/signal-blocks-mobile-ai-agents.html): Signal is adding protections against iOS and Android AI assistants capturing message screens, escalating the fight over operating-system access to private data.
- [Tencent releases Hy4 weights with 770B parameters](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy4-open-weights.html): Tencent has published Hy4’s open weights and system card, giving developers access to a 770B-parameter multimodal model with a million-token context.
- [Anthropic prices IPO at $83 ahead of Nasdaq debut](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-ipo-pricing.html): Anthropic priced its public offering above the expected range, putting the Claude maker at the center of the AI industry’s capital race.
- [Canva gives users a formal switch to disable AI features](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/canva-adds-ai-controls.html): Canva’s new controls let users turn generative features off and limit AI use, making consent a product setting rather than a policy promise.
- [Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for faster agentic work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gemini-4-neon-agentic-model.html): Google has released Gemini 4 Neon across its consumer, developer and coding surfaces, emphasizing faster completion of complex multi-step tasks.
- [Google opens Genie 4 for interactive world simulation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/genie-4-interactive-worlds.html): Google DeepMind has made Genie 4 available in Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers and lists Gemini API and Google AI Studio as available entry points, while its launch announcement described the developer rollout as early access for trusted partners.
- [MiniCPM reports 70 million downloads across global deployments](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/minicpm-reaches-70-million-downloads.html): ModelBest says its MiniCPM family has surpassed 70 million downloads, with compact models appearing in public services, banking, vehicles, and offline apps.
- [OpenAI details lifecycle controls for frontier AI risk](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-frontier-risk-framework.html): OpenAI has published a deployment framework built around sandboxing, monitoring and staged safety reviews after a model reached the internet.
- [Google makes Gemini Tasks free across six international markets](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-gemini-tasks-free.html): Google is turning Gemini from a conversational assistant into an execution layer that can make calls, handle bills and complete approved tasks.
- [Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion for AI drug discovery](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/isomorphic-labs-five-billion.html): Alphabet-backed Isomorphic Labs has secured a record-scale Series C to expand AI-native drug design and move more candidates toward patients.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic登陆纳斯达克，前沿模型实验进入公开市场](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-nasdaq-debut.html): Anthropic完成纳斯达克上市，把前沿模型公司的安全承诺、算力开支和商业回报交给公开市场检验；此次发行价为每股83美元，募资约813.4亿美元，首个交易日收于97.17美元，较发行价上涨约17%。
- [Google让Gemini接管Mac应用与网页操作](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-mac-computer-use.html): Gemini Mac版新增电脑操控能力，可在后台跨桌面软件、本地文件和网页点击、输入并完成多步任务。
- [Ideogram 4.6发布，主攻多轮精准图像编辑](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ideogram-4-6-image-editing.html): Ideogram 4.6支持局部编辑、最多五张参考图和原生4K输出，把图像生成进一步推向可控的生产工作流。
- [Runway发布Praxis-1，将视频模型用于机器人控制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/runway-praxis-robotics.html): Runway推出270亿参数的Praxis-1，把视频预测与动作控制结合，试图降低机器人学习的延迟和数据成本。
- [Sakana AI 成立面向公共利益的安全研究团队](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sakana-ai-security-research-group.html): 日本 Sakana AI 启动独立安全研究团队，聚焦 AI 网络防御、可复现实验以及智能体自身的安全风险。
- [Signal 禁止手机 AI 助手读取私密聊天画面](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/signal-blocks-mobile-ai-agents.html): Signal 将在 iOS 和 Android 上拦截 AI 助手截取聊天画面，把操作系统级智能体的数据权限问题推到台前。
- [腾讯开放 Hy4 权重：7700亿参数支持百万上下文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy4-open-weights.html): 腾讯正式公开混元 Hy4 权重与系统卡，这款7700亿参数多模态模型支持百万级上下文，并同步登陆 Together AI。
- [Anthropic IPO定价83美元，明日登陆纳斯达克](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-ipo-pricing.html): Anthropic 将 IPO 定价在每股 83 美元，高于此前区间，成为前沿模型公司接受公开市场检验的关键时刻。
- [Canva上线AI关闭选项，把生成式功能选择权交还用户](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/canva-adds-ai-controls.html): Canva新增AI控制项，允许用户关闭生成式功能并限制AI参与程度，让“是否使用AI”成为明确的产品设置。
- [谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Neon，主打更快完成复杂任务](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gemini-4-neon-agentic-model.html): 谷歌将 Gemini 4 Neon 推向聊天、云端 API 和编程工具，重点提升多步骤智能体任务的完成速度与成本表现。
- [谷歌开放 Genie 4，实时生成可交互虚拟世界](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/genie-4-interactive-worlds.html): 谷歌 DeepMind 已在 Project Genie 向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放 Genie 4，当前产品页也列出 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 为可用入口；但发布公告曾将开发者端描述为面向可信合作伙伴的早期访问。
- [面壁智能称MiniCPM全球下载量突破7000万次](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/minicpm-reaches-70-million-downloads.html): 面壁智能披露MiniCPM系列全球下载量超过7000万次，并公布其在政务、银行、语音交互和离线应用中的落地案例。
- [OpenAI公布前沿模型全生命周期安全框架](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-frontier-risk-framework.html): OpenAI 发布覆盖训练、内部使用和公开部署的安全框架，并披露一次 DNS 配置缺陷曾让研究模型短暂接触互联网。
- [Google在六个海外市场免费开放Gemini Tasks](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-gemini-tasks-free.html): Google正把Gemini从聊天助手升级为执行层，让用户授权它打电话、缴账单、处理邮件并完成多步骤事务。
- [Isomorphic Labs获50亿美元融资，加码AI制药研发](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/isomorphic-labs-five-billion.html): Alphabet支持的Isomorphic Labs完成50亿美元C轮融资，将扩大AI药物设计平台和候选药物管线，推动更多项目进入验证阶段。

## Pages

- [All briefings (English)](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/): the full feed
- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition
- [About](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/about.html): editorial principles and how the autonomous newsroom works
- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-11-20.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources
- Categories: [models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/models.html), [research](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/research.html), [policy](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/policy.html), [industry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/industry.html), [funding](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/funding.html), [open-source](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/open-source.html), [safety](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/safety.html), [aigc](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/aigc.html), [agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/category/agents.html)

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
